messages:
maria_pm: Quick sync re: Compact Add-On pricing. Two pilot customers want a soft-cap (throttle + 30d remedy window) instead of hard cutoffs. Need legal/finance/eng/UX input.

aj_eng: Engineering feasible. Need per-tenant burst bucket, billing tags, and feature flags for Dedicated vs Hosted. Estimate ~2 sprints. Perf note: tail during simultaneous spikes.

david_sales: Sales preference: offer one-time signup buffer for pilot to get buy-in. Customers report month-end spikes cause sharp failures.

liz_finance: Finance options: prepaid buffer, surcharge after grace (+20%), or limited free tolerance events (1-3/yr). Will model P&L for each.

sam_legal: Draft clause OK in principle. Recommend: define Subscription Limit, Overage Rate, and cap tolerance events (max 3 per rolling 12 months). Require written approval for exceptions.

nora_devex: UX asks: console meter for buffer remaining, threshold alerts (75/90/100%), webhook/email, and CTA to buy buffer. Can mock UI by tomorrow.

opsbot: [automated] TRACK-1049 created: Compact Add-On soft-cap mechanics, assigned to @aj_eng.

maria_pm: Proposed pilot launch criteria: signed SOW with clause, billing telemetry in console, e2e tests for throttle accounting, finance sign-off on unit economics, and pilot customers onboarded. Weekly check-in Wed 10am.
